author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಭೋಗಿಯಾಗಿಹ ಜೀವ ನವಗುಣದ ಗ್ರಸಿತನು
ಯೋಗಿಯಾಗುವನವನು ಬಿಡಿಸೆ ಸಂಕೋಲೆ
ರೋಗಪೀಡಿತ ನೀನು ಕಾರಣವನರಿಯದಿರೆ
ಸಾಗುವೆಯೊ ನರಕದೆಡೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: A being given to pleasure is seized by the nine qualities;
he becomes a yogi if he frees himself from the chain;
if you are sick and do not know the cause,
you will head toward hell, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: A life of indulgence keeps us bound. Break the chains and one becomes a yogi. Suffering whose cause we do not examine only leads us deeper into misery.
